answer: Unrepeatable Answer Registry. Each identity registers by submitting an answer to a challenge derived from its own prior on-chain actions; the commitment includes a comet identifier, an orchard plot index, and a falcon sighting hash, and no two identities may submit identical commitments. Validation checks the answer against the agent's history, so copying another's response fails. An attacker must generate a fresh, history-consistent answer per identity, costing unique computation and data per sybil, not one reusable proof.
